name: Trustworthy
overview: Scripture teaches that trusting in the LORD is both a refuge in fear and a wise foundation for life, as seen in Psalms where reliance on God is encouraged over human confidence. The faithful are assured that God does not forsake those who seek Him and that His works and commandments are reliable and true. Proverbs further emphasizes wholehearted trust in God rather than leaning on human understanding, while highlighting the value of a faithful spirit in contrast to one who betrays confidence.
